topPRs.title: Add new standard versions entries for op-contracts/v7.0.0-rc.4
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
Adds `["op-contracts/v7.0.0-rc.4"]` entries to both `standard-versions-mainnet.toml` and `standard-versions-sepolia.toml`.

Contracts have not been redeployed since [v7.0.0-rc.3](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/releases/tag/op-contracts%2Fv7.0.0-rc.3): the only change between
rc.3 and rc.4 is in `packages/contracts-bedrock/scripts/deploy/DeployOPChain.s.sol` (a deploy-time script that scales `ResourceConfig` for smaller gas limits — see optimism#20925). No `src/`, `semver-lock.json`, or snapshot changes. Therefore the new entries reuse the same implementation addresses as rc.3.

topPRs.title: Add karst (U19) activation timestamps for Sepolia + Mainnet
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Add the Karst (U19) hardfork activation timestamps for the Sepolia and Mainnet superchains plus all participating chain configs:

| Network | Date (UTC) | Unix timestamp |
|---|---|---|
| Sepolia | Wed 17 Jun 2026 16:00:01 UTC | 1781712001 |
| Mainnet | Wed  8 Jul 2026 16:00:01 UTC | 1783526401 |

Both follow the recent `:01` second offset convention (jovian, isthmus, holocene) — guarantees any block landing exactly at 16:00:00 is the final block of the prior fork, with the transition at the next block.

## Files changed

- `superchain/configs/mainnet/superchain.toml`
- `superchain/configs/sepolia/superchain.toml`
- Mainnet chain configs: `op`, `ink`, `metal`, `mode`, `soneium`, `unichain`, `zora`
- Sepolia chain configs: `op`, `ink`, `metal`, `mode`, `soneium-minato`, `unichain`, `zora`

All 14 chains track the superchain default — no per-chain overrides.

## Context

Timestamps were locked in [ethereum-optimism/solutions#668](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/solutions/issues/668) on 2026-05-23.

This PR covers only the activation timestamps. OPCM addresses, contract implementations, and the Karst kona absolute prestate hash will land in follow-up PRs as those artifacts become available:
- Post-audit OPCM deploy → tracked in ethereum-optimism/solutions#441
- Kona absolute prestate review → tracked in ethereum-optimism/solutions#697

## Note for reviewers

If the SCR `Hardforks` struct (`ops/internal/config/chain.go`) and validation wiring don't yet recognize `karst_time`, that wiring needs to land first (or alongside this PR). Upstream support exists in op-geth + op-node (`KarstTime` field in `rollup.Config`); this is just the SCR plumbing.
